tool_input.content:
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Border, Side

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# 1. Arial font for all cells
for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for cell in row:
        cell.font = Font(name='Arial')

# 2. Titles on row 1: bold, italic, bordered
thin = Side(style='thin')
border = Border(left=thin, right=thin, top=thin, bottom=thin)
for c in range(1, 11):
    cell = ws.cell(1, c)
    cell.font = Font(name='Arial', bold=True, italic=True)
    cell.border = border

# 3. Column D filled with #CCCCCC beginning in D2
fill = PatternFill(start_color='CCCCCC', end_color='CCCCCC', fill_type='solid')
for r in range(2, 36):
    ws.cell(r, 4).fill = fill

# 4. Formula in column A (A2:A35) to search columns I:J for a person's name based on Title and Department code
#    Title is in column B, Department Code in column C.
#    Search I:J for matching Title (I) and Department Code (J), return Name (H).
for r in range(2, 36):
    ws.cell(r, 1).fill = PatternFill(start_color='FCD5B4', end_color='FCD5B4', fill_type='solid')
    ws.cell(r, 1).value = f'=IFERROR(INDEX($H$2:$H$35,MATCH(1,($I$2:$I$35=$B{r})*($J$2:$J$35=$C{r}),0)),"")'

# 5. Hide gridlines
ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
